evidence.summary: OFAC lists it as the All-Russian Scientific Research Institute of Experimental Physics (VNIIEF), the Russian Federal Nuclear Center in Sarov, Nizhny Novgorod Region, also known as the Khariton Institute and the Sarov Nuclear Weapons Plant. The US Treasury says VNIIEF performs experimental testing of Russia’s nuclear weapons.
It is a Russian federal state unitary enterprise, as its full name on OFAC’s list says.
